subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about paying on the qualified lead rather than the click. In its 2026 outlook Zillow says AI will start coordinating the buyer and seller match to the right agent end to end, so platforms that score and route intent cleanest win this cycle. With Zillow Premier Agent leads running $20 to $150 and far higher in coastal ZIPs (ylopo 2026), validated lead quality decides the CPS line. That is where our holdout-measured incrementality earns its place. Want to compare it against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Zillow 2026 AI buyer-seller-to-agent matching (sourced) + Premier Agent CPL band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN real_estate_proptech: acknowledges second follow-up + references prior framing; fresh angle = timely sourced development (Zillow 2026 AI-coordinated buyer/seller-to-agent matching) + real market band (Zillow Premier Agent $20-$150 lead cost, ylopo 2026), both web-verified with URLs in enrichment_sources; MobUpps incrementality referenced without a figure; exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off, no em-dash, no 'X, not Y' (positive 'paying on the qualified lead rather than the click'); native English; brand Zillow named only from candidates, no cross_border rival.
